claims.claim: The exact one-DOF attachment transpose preserves three-coordinate power.
claims.assumptions: Integer B, force and angular velocity in compatible positive scales; the velocity mapping B*omega is assumed.
claims.implementation: web/anatomical-transfer.mjs: attachmentMap returns B; tendonTransfer computes QNm=dot(B,boneForce).
claims.numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical-fixture.test.mjs independently differences the actual energy and rigid map and checks power.
claims.limitations: Does not prove the geometric derivative, floating-point equality, solver convergence, anatomical axis, material response or biology.
